title: The 5 Best Automatic Pet Feeders for Multi-Pet Households
h1: The 5 Best Automatic Pet Feeders for Multi-Pet Households
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for automatic pet feeders for multi-pet households, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at automatic pet feeders for multi-pet households using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder Connect
products.blurb: Key specs: Opens only for the registered pet's microchip or RFID collar tag, Sealed lid keeps food fresh between visits, Training mode opens the lid gradually for timid pets.
strengths: The only feeder in this list that physically blocks a second pet from opening the bowl
Sealed lid keeps wet or dry food noticeably fresher than open-bowl feeders
Long 3-year warranty versus the 1 to 2 years typical of competitors
limitations: The Connect app and remote feeding history require a separately sold hub
Stores one meal at a time rather than a full day's schedule like hopper feeders
Learning curve during the first week while pets adjust to the lid opening
features: Opens only for the registered pet's microchip or RFID collar tag
Sealed lid keeps food fresh between visits
Training mode opens the lid gradually for timid pets
Connect version links to the Sure Petcare app via a separate hub

products.name: PetSafe Smart Feed Automatic Dog & Cat Feeder
products.blurb: Key specs: 24-cup / 6L hopper capacity, Wi-Fi app control with up to 12 scheduled meals per day, Portions from 1/8 cup to 4 cups.
strengths: Large 24-cup hopper covers a multi-pet household for a week or more between refills
Optional meal-splitter accessory divides one hopper's output into two bowls
Slow Feed setting slows down a fast eater without buying a separate bowl
limitations: No built-in mechanism to stop one pet from eating a second pet's portion
Meal splitter only divides a single feeding, not different food types
Wi-Fi dependent for schedule changes and remote feeding
features: Wi-Fi app control with up to 12 scheduled meals per day
Slow Feed setting spreads a meal over about 15 minutes
Backup batteries keep the schedule running through a power outage

products.name: PETLIBRO Granary Camera Feeder with AI Multi-Pet Recognition
products.blurb: Key specs: 1080p camera with night vision and 360-degree auto tracking, AI recognition identifies individual cats without a chip or tag, Two-way audio and motion/sound alerts.
strengths: Logs which cat approached and how much it ate without any hardware on the pet
Camera and two-way audio double as a general pet-monitoring tool
Daily activity summaries flag feeding pattern changes worth mentioning to a vet
limitations: AI recognition doesn't physically stop a pet from eating from the wrong bowl
Cloud video history requires a paid subscription beyond basic alerts
Newer product with a smaller review history than the PetSafe or SureFeed
features: 1080p camera with night vision and 360-degree auto tracking
AI recognition identifies individual cats without a chip or tag
Daily activity analysis and per-pet feeding summaries in the app

products.name: PETLIBRO Granary 5L Wi-Fi Automatic Pet Feeder
strengths: App scheduling for up to 10 meals a day
5-liter hopper lasts several days for one cat or small dog
Battery backup keeps scheduled meals running during power cuts
limitations: Needs a 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi setup for remote features
Portion size varies with kibble shape

products.name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder for 2 Cats (Dual Bowls)
limitations: Doesn't stop one cat eating both portions

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
